metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Wait, did I just help?’ and I said ‘Thanks!’
metadata.description:
Wait, did the enemy just stand still like it was a statue?
My aim was on break but the kill still hit.
Click if you love those accidental clutch moments!
Tap if your kills feel like glitches in the matrix.

Tap if your aim clocks in late but still gets the job done!
